independence_evidence: Launched in 2003 by a group of journalists and public-space advocates and published by Spacing Media, Toronto, which also runs the Spacing Store (https://spacing.ca/about/, https://spacing.ca/contact/).
qualifies_reason: Independent Toronto urbanism magazine with print Issue 76 (Fall 2026) on sale.
what_it_is: A landscape-format magazine about Toronto's public realm: transit, streets, housing, parks, urban design, civic politics and city history, with a themed feature section each issue. Issue 76 profiles the people and groups shaping the 2026 municipal election. It is for readers interested in how Canadian cities work and who want to get involved in them.
